jobs.title: Head of Finance, Al-Futtaim Health, Dubai
jobs.normalized_title: head of finance al futtaim health dubai
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID: 179448 

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate. 

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day

 Healthcare Finance Experience is Essential 

HealthHub, part of Al-Futtaim Health, is seeking an experienced Head of Healthcare Finance to lead the financial performance, strategic planning, and commercial finance activities of our growing healthcare business.

Reporting directly to the Managing Director, this senior leadership role will partner closely with operational and clinical leaders to drive performance across our network of community-based outpatient clinics, healthcare services, diagnostic operations, and future hospital expansion initiatives.

 Applicants without significant healthcare finance experience will not be considered. 

We are specifically seeking candidates who have held senior finance leadership positions within hospitals, healthcare groups, clinic networks, medical centres, day surgery facilities, or other healthcare providers.

 About the Role 

 This is not a traditional accounting or reporting role. 

We are looking for a commercially focused healthcare finance leader who understands the operational realities of delivering healthcare services and can translate financial information into meaningful business decisions.

The successful candidate will have experience supporting multi-site healthcare operations and working directly with executives, physicians, operational leaders, and corporate stakeholders.

You will play a key role in shaping financial strategy, supporting healthcare growth initiatives, improving operational performance, and ensuring strong financial governance across the business.

 Key Responsibilities 

Healthcare Financial Performance
Drive financial performance across clinics and healthcare business units
Partner with operational leaders to improve profitability and operational efficiency
Monitor physician productivity, revenue trends, patient volumes, service line performance, and payer mix
Identify opportunities to improve financial and operational outcomes
Support business growth and healthcare service development initiatives

 Financial Planning & Strategy 

Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes
Develop financial models and strategic business cases
Support new clinic developments, healthcare expansion projects, and future hospital initiatives
Deliver meaningful financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership
Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic growth initiatives
Governance & Controls
Ensure robust financial controls, compliance, governance, and audit readiness
Oversee monthly management reporting and financial performance reviews
Manage statutory requirements and external audit relationships
Support risk management and business continuity initiatives

 Leadership 

Lead and develop a high-performing finance team
Foster a culture of accountability, partnership, and continuous improvement
Act as a trusted advisor to executive and operational leadership teams

 Essential Requirements 

Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline
Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, or CFA
Minimum 10 years of progressive finance experience
Minimum 5 years in a senior finance leadership position
Extensive Healthcare Finance Experience Within:
Hospitals
Healthcare Groups
Medical Centres
Clinic Networks
Day Surgery Centres
Multi-site Healthcare Operations
Demonstrated Experience In:
Healthcare Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
Healthcare business partnering
Healthcare operations finance
Physician productivity analysis
Revenue cycle and healthcare KPIs
Payer mix analysis
Multi-site healthcare performance management
Business case development and healthcare investments
Candidates Unlikely to Be Suitable

 This position is not intended for candidates whose experience is primarily within: 

Banking
Manufacturing
FMCG
Retail
Construction
Audit-only environments
Corporate FP&A without healthcare operations exposure

Applicants must be able to demonstrate direct experience supporting healthcare delivery businesses.

 What's on Offer 

Senior leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director
Significant influence over financial and operational strategy
Exposure to healthcare expansion and future hospital development projects
Opportunity to work alongside experienced clinical and operational leaders
Competitive executive compensation and benefits package
Long-term career growth within one of the UAE's most respected healthcare organizations

 About Al-Futtaim Healthcare 

 We Hear Your Ambition. 

For over 90 years, the Al-Futtaim Group has been bringing the world’s leading brands of lifestyle watches, cars, home furnishings and fashion to the UAE. The Group has now introduced a whole new way of holistic healthcare through HealthHub Clinics by Al-Futtaim, its multi-speciality chain of more than 20 clinics in Dubai with over 25 specialties offering the right combination of advanced diagnostics, proven medical expertise and specialised services . 

What gives our clinics an edge is that as a part of the Al-Futtaim Group, you can expect world-class quality standards, with access to the best medical services and facilities within a healing environment. It’s a new way of healthcare that’s designed to meet a patient’s needs with a complete range of smart healthcare solutions. As testimony to this, only recently, we’ve earned a rare milestone of being the only primary healthcare network in the UAE to receive the Gold Seal by a reputed international body: Accreditation Canada. 

As trusted partners to health, we at HealthHub Clinics adopt evidence-based learning that enables us to listen to our patients more carefully. It helps us in treating the cause and not just the symptoms, while applying global best practices to ensure quality of care for every family member. Most of all, we adopt a patient-centric approach to healthcare that is reflected in the promise of our core belief: “ We Hear You. ”

jobs.title: Director – Asset Management (Residential/Commercial)
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE 

 Own the residential/commercial asset-class strategy and performance, aligned with overall portfolio objectives. Drive NOI, occupancy, asset value and sustainable returns through active asset management. Lead leasing, asset enhancement and commercialization to optimize asset performance and value. Leverage AI, analytics and market insights to enhance asset-level decisions and performance.

 REPORTING LINES 

 Report To: Chief Portfolio Management Officer or Executive Director – Portfolio Management Internal Reports From: Associate Asset Management Key Internal Interfaces: D-Hold: brief alignment, project delivery, handover | Legal: lease docs, land titles, operator contracts, JV agreements | Finance: business planning, CAPEX approvals, valuations | M&A: acquisitions/disposals | Khidmah (FM): CAPEX execution | Strategy & Corporate Development | HR | IT/Digital: smart building, tenant portal External Interaction: Asteco (leasing), residential tenants, brokers, valuers, insurance providers, government housing entities (DoM, DMT), JV partners.

 ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

 Asset Strategy & Performance Own the asset management strategy and business plan for the assigned residential/commercial portfolio. Shape asset-class positioning and the multi-year hold, enhance or exit view in line with portfolio strategy and market cycle. Deliver NOI, occupancy, rental growth and asset performance against approved targets. Monitor asset performance and drive corrective actions and value-enhancement initiatives.

 Leasing & Commercial Optimization Lead leasing, pricing and retention strategies based on market positioning and asset performance. Set tenant-mix, anchor and covenant strategy to strengthen asset positioning and long-term income quality. Drive commercialization and ancillary income opportunities to diversify and enhance asset revenues. Use market intelligence and customer/tenant insights to optimize commercial decisions.

 Asset Enhancement & Value Creation Lead asset enhancement and repositioning initiatives based on business cases, returns and strategic priorities. Build and defend investment cases for enhancement capital and track realized returns against underwriting. Recommend hold, enhance, reposition or exit actions based on asset performance and portfolio strategy. Partner with Development on asset requirements, design considerations and handover readiness.

 Operational & Partner Oversight Oversee property/facility management and external operators against agreed financial, operational and service KPIs. Ensure effective asset delivery, regulatory compliance and management of key asset-level risks. Embed ESG, sustainability and customer-experience standards across the assigned assets. Manage relevant JV and strategic partner interfaces for assigned assets.

 Analytics, AI & Stakeholder Management Leverage AI, advanced analytics and market intelligence to strengthen forecasting, performance insights and asset decisions. Benchmark asset performance against market comparables to inform pricing, capital and strategic decisions. Provide asset-level insights and recommendations to Portfolio Management and relevant governance forums. Collaborate with Finance, Investment & Capital Planning and Portfolio Performance & Intelligence on planning and performance.

 FINANCIAL ACCOUNTABILITY 

 Owns the residential P&L, NOI target and CAPEX/OpEx budget. Recommends enhancement and leasing spend within DoA.

 KEY RESULT AREAS Asset Financial Performance – NOI, occupancy and rental growth vs. plan Asset Value Creation – enhancement, repositioning and commercial returns Operational Performance – operator performance and asset KPIs delivered Asset Optimization – leasing, pricing, retention and asset utilization AI & Performance Insights – analytics driving forecasts and asset decisions

 WORKING CONDITIONS Regular working hours, office based with travel as needed.

 YoE / QUALIFICATIONS / SKILLS 

 RELATED YEARS OF EXPERIENCE 

 Min. 14+ years, with at least 7 years in residential or commercial asset management or property investment within a REIT, fund or institutional developer.

 YoE IN MANAGERIAL POSITION 

 Min. 6+ years managing teams and service providers.

 FIELD OF EXPERIENCE 

 Residential real estate asset management, leasing, property investment, place-making.

 TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS 

 Deep knowledge of UAE residential market dynamics, leasing and competitive landscape. Proven track record developing and executing asset enhancement programs. Strong financial modeling and P&L management skills. Experience with JV governance structures and management agreement enforcement. Ability to develop IC submissions and Board-level papers. Knowledge of UAE land ownership, title, RERA and ADM regulations. Experience with sustainability frameworks (Estidama, LEED) and energy efficiency programs. Ability to leverage AI and digital analytics for forecasting, performance optimization and asset decision-making.

 QUALIFICATION 

 Bachelors in engineering, Finance, Economics, Real Estate or related; master's degree preferable. MRICS or equivalent an advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Finance
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities 

 1. Revenue Assurance & Controls 

 Ensure end‑to‑end revenue integrity across all business units—order‑to‑cash, billing, invoicing, and collections.

 Design, implement, and monitor strong internal controls to prevent revenue leakage.

 Lead periodic revenue reconciliation , variance analysis, and root-cause investigations.

 Review and validate pricing, contracts, discounts, promotions, and revenue adjustments.

 Drive compliance with IFRS and organizational policies for revenue recognition.

 2. Process Excellence & Transformation 

 Lead large-scale process transformation initiatives within the Shared Services Center to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and automation.

 Implement digital tools such as RPA, workflow automation, analytics dashboards, and AI/ML-based anomaly detection .

 Redesign workflows for standardization across geographies and businesses.

 Create KPIs and dashboards to measure performance, leakage, recovery, and process stability.

 3. Leadership & Stakeholder Management 

 Manage and mentor a multi-disciplinary team responsible for billing, audits, assurance checks, and reporting.

 Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—Finance, Operations, IT, Commercial, Data Analytics.

 Influence senior stakeholders with insights and recommendations backed by strong analytics.

 Partner with internal audit and external auditors on revenue-related reviews.

 4. Continuous Improvement & Value Creation 

 Identify systemic gaps in revenue processes and execute corrective actions.

 Develop a roadmap for shared services scalability and maturity .

 Introduce best practices from global Shared Services/GBS frameworks.

 Establish governance models for periodic business reviews and improvement cycles.

 5. Reporting & Analytics 

 Deliver accurate and timely revenue assurance MIS, dashboards, KPIs, and performance scorecards.

 Analyze trends, identify anomalies, and highlight risks/opportunities.

 Prepare executive-level presentations for senior leadership and CFO reviews.

 Chartered Accountant with 8-10 years of experience
 7–12 years of experience in Finance Shared Services , Revenue Assurance , or Order-to-Cash , with at least 3–5 years in a managerial role.
 Proven track record leading transformational or digitalization projects .
 Strong understanding of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, MS Dynamics) and automation tools (Power BI, Power Automate, RPA).
 Solid grasp of internal controls, contract management, and financial governance.

jobs.title: Vice President – Asset Management (Commercial)
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE
Lead the strategic management of Aldar's assigned commercial assets to maximize portfolio value, optimize financial performance, and enhance customer experience. Drive asset performance through leasing strategy, capital investment, service provider governance, sustainability initiatives, and cross-functional collaboration while supporting Aldar's long-term investment objectives.
The role is for the UAE national
 
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Strategic Asset & Portfolio Management
Develop and implement asset strategies to maximize long-term value and portfolio performance.
Drive portfolio optimization through asset repositioning, enhancement, and capital recycling initiatives.
Monitor market trends and asset performance to support strategic decision-making.
2. Financial Performance & Capital Management
Manage portfolio financial performance, including NOI, occupancy, yield, valuation, and total return.
Identify value creation opportunities and oversee annual business planning, budgeting, and financial reporting.
Support investment decisions through financial analysis and performance insights.
3. Leasing, Commercialisation & Tenant Experience
Lead leasing strategies to maximize occupancy, rental growth, and tenant retention.
Identify commercialisation opportunities and oversee tenant engagement initiatives to improve customer satisfaction and NPS.
Review key leasing transactions and ensure alignment with portfolio objectives.
4. Asset Enhancement & Development Coordination
Lead asset enhancement programmes and CAPEX initiatives to improve asset performance and customer experience.
Coordinate with Development, Legal, Finance, and Operations to ensure successful project delivery and asset handover.
Monitor post-completion performance against approved business cases.
5. Service Provider Governance
Oversee the performance of Property and Facilities Management service providers through agreed SLAs, KPIs, and governance frameworks.
Drive continuous improvement, operational excellence, and cost optimization across the portfolio.
6. Stakeholder & Portfolio Collaboration
Partner with internal business units, including Development, Finance, Legal, Retail, Hospitality, and Education, to deliver integrated portfolio initiatives.
Build and maintain effective relationships with tenants, brokers, consultants, contractors, and external stakeholders.
 
RELATED YEARS OF EXPERIENCE
Min of 10+ years of at least 5 years of experience in real estate, property and asset management, investment banking, buy side or sell side advisory or other related field.
 
YOE IN MANAGERIAL POSITION
Min of 2+ years in a related managerial position
 
FIELD OF EXPERIENCE
Banking, real estate consultancy, management consultancy.
 
TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS
Outstanding analytical and quantitative skills; proficiency with standard software, including MS Office; advanced Excel skills is a must.
Proven track record in conducting valuation / financial models.
Able to analyze, evaluate and move quickly to support rapid decision making.
Ability to interpret and manage transaction documentation: NDAs, MoUs, LoI’s, and SPA’s
Ability to develop Board level papers and investment memoranda.
 
QUALIFICATION
Bachelor Degree in Engineering, Economics, Finance or Accounting, MBA (Finance), CFA, CA or CPA preferred.

jobs.normalized_title: senior vice president commercial strategy and analysis
jobs.description:
Job Purpose: 

 •Lead the development and execution of Aldar Development’s Commercial strategy, ensuring full alignment with the company’s broader objectives and long-term goals.

 •Establish a data-driven culture within Commercial, spearheading analytics and BI to inform decision-making, performance monitoring, and strategic planning.

 •Serve as the key strategic partner to the Chief Commercial Officer, translating market intelligence and performance data into actionable business strategies.

 Job Responsibilities: 

 Strategy Development & Execution 

 •Develop and lead Aldar Development’s overall Commercial strategy, integrating inputs across Sales, CX, Marketing, and Operations.

 •Cascade the Commercial strategy to all business units, ensuring alignment and assisting in developing departmental scorecards and strategic initiatives.

 •Lead strategic planning processes including market assessments, financial modelling, and competitive analysis.

 •Drive digital transformation and innovation initiatives within the Commercial function.

 •Act as primary contact for senior leadership on commercial strategy, performance, and operational improvements.

 Data Analysis & Performance Monitoring 

 •Establish and maintain a robust data analytics and business intelligence capability across Commercial.

 •Oversee commercial forecasting, providing accurate revenue projections, budgets, and scenario planning.

 •Ensure availability, accuracy, and timeliness of data, dashboards, and performance reports for commercial leadership.

 •Monitor market trends, competitive dynamics, and macroeconomic conditions to identify opportunities and risks.

 •Champion the use of BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, CRM analytics) across the function.

 Reporting & Stakeholder Management 

 •Prepare and present regular commercial performance reports and strategic insights to the CCO and senior leadership.

 •Track key financial and non-financial KPIs including revenue performance, NPS, and sales efficiency.

 •Ensure Commercial activities operate within budget while maximizing ROI.

 • Partner with Group Strategy on consolidated reporting, target-setting, and manpower planning.

 Years of Experience: 

 •Min 12+ years of strategy and analytics experience in a large multinational company, real estate firm, or top-tier management consultancy. Deep expertise in strategy deployment frameworks and GCC real estate market dynamics.

 YoE in Managerial Position

Role Summary:
The Senior Manager – Finance (Factory) is responsible for managing end-to-end finance operations at the factory level, ensuring robust financial control, accurate reporting, and operational finance support to manufacturing operations. The role is hands-on and execution-focused, acting as the key finance partner to Factory Operations while ensuring alignment with GMG’s Group finance policies, controls, and standards. The role covers core operational finance pillars, with a strong emphasis on compliance, efficiency, and cost discipline within a manufacturing environment.

Key Success Drivers including Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

1. Financial Control & Compliance

Ensure strict adherence to GMG Group finance policies, internal controls, and governance frameworks at the factory level

Maintain strong financial discipline across all manufacturing transactions, including inventory, procurement, and production costing

Lead and support internal and external audits, ensuring timely closure of audit findings and zero compliance gaps

Safeguard company assets through effective control mechanisms and regular reconciliations

2. Factory Financial Operations & Reporting

Oversee end-to-end factory finance operations, including month-end close, journal entries, and balance sheet reconciliations

Ensure timely, accurate, and insightful financial reporting aligned with Group timelines and standards

Drive transparency and accuracy in inventory accounting and valuation

3. Cost Management & Efficiency

Partner with factory operations to drive cost optimization initiatives across materials, labor, and overheads

Analyze production costs, variances, and inefficiencies, providing actionable insights to improve margins

Track and control factory budgets, ensuring alignment with approved financial plans

Lead initiatives to improve productivity and reduce waste within the manufacturing process

4. Business Partnering with Factory Operations

People Management:

• Lead and develop the factory finance team.

• Allocate work, review outputs, and ensure high-quality deliverables.

• Build strong finance capability within the factory through coaching and on-the-job development.

• Promote a culture of accountability, discipline, and continuous improvement.

Strong manufacturing finance knowledge (costing, BOM, variances, inventory)

Financial reporting & month-end close expertise

Internal controls, compliance, and audit management

ERP systems and advanced Excel skills

Data analysis and business partnering for decision support

Working capital and inventory management

Educational Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.

• Master’s degree is an advantage.

Experience:
• 8–12 years of progressive experience in finance roles, with significant exposure to manufacturing or factory environments.

• Proven experience managing factory-level finance operations.

• Experience working in large, structured organizations with strong governance frameworks.

AFGRE is responsible for master planning of all projects in its portfolio, including two large scale mixed use destinations: Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

What you'll be doing  

As a Finance Manager, you will act as the key finance partner for one of our brands, ensuring strong financial control, accurate reporting, and commercial insight to support day-to-day trading decisions. The role will also play a critical part in setting up and supporting a new strategic project, ensuring financial discipline, scalability, and strong governance from inception. This role is highly operational and hands-on, with close interaction across finance, operations, and commercial teams to drive performance and profitability.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Act as the primary business finance partner for the brand, ensuring strong financial control, accurate reporting, and commercial insight to support day-to-day operations.

  • Partner closely with Planning, Retail, GM and Ecommerce teams to support decision-making and drive overall business performance.

  • Manage financial reporting including weekly, monthly, and ad-hoc performance analysis across sales, margin, and inventory.

  • Monitor and drive profitability across the liquidation business, ensuring tight control over costs, pricing, and stock efficiency.

  • Support forecasting and budgeting processes, ensuring alignment with commercial plans and trading performance.

  • Provide financial input into operational and trading decisions, ensuring data-led decision-making across all channels.

  • Support the end-to-end setup and financial governance of a new strategic project, ensuring scalability and control from launch.

  • Identify risks and opportunities across trading performance and proactively recommend corrective actions.

  • Improve and streamline financial processes to support a fast-moving, high-volume operational business.

  • Deliver clear, actionable insights to senior stakeholders to influence strategy and execution.

What you’ll need to succeed  

  • You hold a degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field.

  • You preferably hold a professional qualification such as ACCA, CA, CMA.

  • You possess 3 to 5 years of experience in finance, ideally within retail, trading, FMCG, or high-volume operational environments.

  • You have a strong understanding of P&L management, inventory accounting, and margin analysis.

  • You have experience working in fast-paced, commercially driven businesses with tight operational cycles.

  • You have the ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable business insights.

  • You possess strong Excel and financial modelling skills; experience with SAP systems and Looker is a plus.

  • You have a proven ability to partner with non-finance stakeholders, especially operations teams.

  • You are comfortable working in a hands-on, execution-focused role with high levels of ambiguity.

  • You have experience supporting or leading project-based work or new business launches.

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United A”rab Emirates. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organisation to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate. 

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day. 

 Job Purpose 

 The Assistant Vice President - Compliance is responsible for supporting the VP-Compliance in ensuring the Company’s adherence to applicable regulatory requirements, with primary responsibility for compliance matters relating to health insurance and the requirements of the Dubai Health Authority (DHA) and Department of Health (DOH) in Abu Dhabi. 

 The role will also support VP- Compliance in the implementation and monitoring of the Company’s overall compliance framework and in handling other matters as assigned. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 1. Health Insurance Regulatory Compliance – Primary Responsibility 

 Review products, policy terms, underwriting, enrolment, claims, pre-authorization, reimbursement and complaints for regulatory compliance. 

 Oversee compliance risks relating to provider networks, brokers, outsourcing partners and TPAs, including due diligence, contracts, service levels, data access and audit rights. 

 Monitor laws, regulations, standards, circulars, notices and other requirements issued by the Dubai Health Authority (DHA) and the Department of Health in Abu Dhabi and ensure coordination with the above authorities. 

 Coordinate with Health Insurance, Claims, Underwriting, Operations, IT and other relevant departments to ensure timely implementation of regulatory requirements. 

 Maintain an updated register of applicable health insurance regulatory requirements and monitor the Company’s compliance with such requirements. 

 Review health insurance policies and procedures from a regulatory compliance perspective. 

 Support the preparation and submission of regulatory reports, responses, confirmations and other information required by the relevant health authorities. 

 Coordinate and follow up on regulatory inspections, reviews, audits, observations and remediation actions relating to health insurance. 

 Monitor regulatory deadlines and ensure that required actions and submissions are completed within the prescribed timelines. 

 Escalate material compliance issues, regulatory breaches or implementation delays to the VP- Compliance. 

 Promote fair customer outcomes and transparent disclosures in health insurance activities and monitor health insurance complaints from a regulatory compliance perspective. 

 Provide compliance support in relation to financial crime controls and medical-fraud investigations; advise on privacy, consent, confidentiality, retention and health-data sharing. 

 2. Compliance Monitoring and Assurance 

 Execute risk-based reviews, report findings, establish accountable actions, validate closure and escalate material breaches. 

 Maintain appropriate documentation and evidence demonstrating compliance with applicable regulatory requirements. 

 Follow up with business units on agreed compliance remediation actions and report overdue or material matters to the VP- Compliance. 

 Assist VP- Compliance in preparing compliance reports, maintain regulatory records, deliver targeted training and support enterprise-wide compliance initiatives. 

 3. General Compliance Support 

 Monitor compliance with applicable insurance laws, regulations, standards and regulatory circulars. 

 Conduct regulatory gap assessments and support implementation of new regulatory requirements. 

 Review internal policies, procedures, products, agreements and business initiatives from a compliance perspective. 

 Support the preparation and updating of the Compliance Framework, Compliance Plan and related policies and procedures. 

 Perform any other compliance-related duties assigned by the VP- Compliance. 

 Qualifications and Experience 

 Bachelor’s degree in law, Finance, Business, Insurance, Healthcare Administration or a related field; relevant professional qualification preferred. 

 Typically, 10–12 years’ relevant experience, including 5 years in a managerial or senior advisory role. 

 Strong knowledge of UAE insurance regulation and practical medical-insurance experience. 

 Experience with regulators, inspections, remediation and senior governance forums. 

 Understanding of medical underwriting, claims, provider contracting, TPAs, coding, billing, outsourcing and health-data risks. 

 About Orient Insurance PJSC 

 Orient Insurance Company commenced operations in 1982 as a part of the reputed Al-Futtaim Group and has since recorded a progressively steady growth. The Company is counted among the leaders in the UAE insurance market. Orient Insurance Company has a paid-up capital of AED 500 Million which is the highest in the insurance industry in UAE. With head office in Dubai, the company serves its clientele through an extensive branch network in Jebel Ali, Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah in UAE, Muscat in Sultanate of Oman, Riyadh in Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and Bahrain.

 VAT Compliance & Regulatory Management

 Operations Governance 

 Review and validate key VAT controls to ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. 

 Monitor VAT-related KPIs, dashboards and compliance metrics. 

 Ensure timely closure of VAT exceptions, unresolved reconciliations and reporting discrepancies. 

 Drive standardization of VAT processes across entities, business units and jurisdictions. 

 Tax Technology, Automation & Process Improvement 

 Drive automation initiatives to improve VAT compliance, reconciliation, reporting and monitoring processes. 

 Partner with IT, Finance Transformation and external vendors to implement tax technology solutions. 

 Develop dashboards and analytical tools to improve visibility over VAT risks, compliance status and operational performance. 

 Reporting & Management Information 

 Prepare and present VAT compliance status reports, risk assessments and operational dashboards to senior management. 

 Monitor key performance indicators related to VAT compliance, filing accuracy, exception management and process efficiency. 

 Support leadership with insights and recommendations to strengthen tax governance and operational effectiveness.

 6–7 years of experience in GCC VAT, Indirect Tax compliance or Shared Services operations. 

 Strong knowledge of UAE VAT and exposure to KSA VAT regulations.

 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 

 Prior experience with ERP systems such as Oracle or Microsoft Dynamics. 

 Exposure to VAT automation, Tax Technology and process transformation initiatives. 

 MBA Finance/ CA/ CMA/ ACCA (completed or part qualified)

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Finance Manager | FMCG 
 Location: Dubai, UAE
 Industry: FMCG
 Experience: 6–10 years
 Qualification: CA / Chartered Accountant

 About the Role
 Our client is seeking a high-calibre Finance Manager to join a leading FMCG organization in Dubai. This role will work closely with senior leadership and will combine strong financial expertise with business partnering, strategic analysis, performance management, and executive-level reporting.
 The ideal candidate will be commercially oriented, highly analytical, and comfortable converting complex financial and business information into clear insights, presentations, dashboards, and actionable recommendations for senior management.

 Key Responsibilities
 FP&A & Business Performance
 Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and periodic business review processes.
 Develop and maintain financial models to support business planning and decision-making.
 Analyze revenue, margins, costs, profitability, working capital, and key business KPIs.
 Track actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and business plans, highlighting key variances and underlying drivers.
 Provide forward-looking insights and recommendations to improve business performance.
 Support scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and evaluation of strategic business initiatives.
 Management Reporting & Presentations
 Prepare high-quality monthly, quarterly, and annual management reports for senior leadership.
 Develop executive presentations, dashboards, charts, and business review decks that clearly communicate financial and operational performance.
 Translate financial data into concise business insights and actionable recommendations.
 Prepare business performance packs for leadership meetings and strategic reviews.
 Build visually strong and easy-to-understand financial presentations for senior stakeholders.
 Business Partnering
 Partner closely with commercial, sales, supply chain, operations, and other functional teams to understand business performance.
 Work with business leaders to identify opportunities, risks, cost optimization areas, and growth levers.
 Challenge assumptions and provide an independent financial perspective on key business decisions.
 Support leadership in evaluating new initiatives, investments, pricing decisions, market opportunities, and business cases.
 Strategic & Leadership Support
 Conduct analysis on key strategic priorities and prepare decision-support materials for senior management.
 Coordinate cross-functional inputs for important business initiatives and ensure timely follow-up on agreed actions.
 Monitor key organizational priorities, milestones, and performance indicators.
 Support senior leadership with ad-hoc analysis, research, business cases, and financial insights as required.
 Bring structure, rigor, and data-driven thinking to strategic and operational discussions.

 Candidate Profile
 CA / Chartered Accountant with 6–10 years of relevant experience .
 Strong experience in FP&A, management reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis .
 Prior experience in FMCG is strongly preferred ; candidates from other high-volume, consumer-facing businesses may also be considered.
 Strong commercial understanding with the ability to connect financial performance to business drivers.
 Excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills, with the ability to create compelling presentations, dashboards, charts, and financial models.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 Comfortable working with senior management and cross-functional stakeholders.
 Able to operate in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with multiple priorities.
 Strong attention to detail while maintaining a broader strategic perspective.
 Proactive, mature, and highly organized, with the ability to independently drive projects and follow through on key actions.

 Key Competencies
 FP&A & Financial Planning
 Commercial Finance
 Business Performance Management
 Financial Modelling & Analysis
 Management Reporting
 Executive Presentations
 Data Visualization & Dashboards
 Strategic Business Analysis
 Cross-functional Stakeholder Management
 Problem Solving & Decision Support

 Ideal Profile
 The ideal candidate will be a CA with strong FMCG finance experience who combines financial depth with commercial acumen and executive presence . Someone who is equally confident in building a financial model, analyzing business performance, preparing a senior-management presentation, and working across functions to drive key business priorities.
 This is a high-visibility role suited to someone who wants to work closely with senior leadership and have broad exposure across the business.

 Job Description:

jobs.title: Inventory Controller - Logistics
jobs.description:
About Us 
 As a leader in luxury retail in the Middle East, Al Tayer Group's retail division, Al Tayer Insignia, hosts a portfolio of some of the world’s best luxury brands in the fashion, jewellery, home and department store categories. Complementing its position in luxury retail, Al Tayer Insignia has also built new frontiers in lifestyle retail, representing leading brands in the Beauty, Home, Fashion and Hospitality sectors. Our brands include Bloomingdales, Harvey Nichols and Armani to name just a few!
 Job Purpose 
 
To manage & monitor the inventory and stock holdings ensuring system stock issues are minimized. Monitor and control movement of stock, formulate policies and control procedures in order to maintain minimum discrepancies. Ensure all returns to suppliers are managed & monitored.
 
 Strategic Roles and Responsibilities 
 Custodian of Business inventory and responsible for overall inventory management operations.
 Responsible for warehouse storage space optimization, ABC analysis, heat map analysis and implementation
 Implement stock loss action plans (formulated as a result of cycle counts/stock counts) in conjunction with Loss Prevention Team
 Review and monitor extent of damages in the WH and come up with action plan to mitigate the occurrence in conjunction with warehouse inbound and outbound operations
 Execution on WH shrinkage analysis and reductions.
 Ensure timeliness & integrity of all inventory transaction
 
 Functional Roles and Responsibilities 
 Conduct investigation of inventory discrepancies identified during cycle count or picking and take action to rectify the discrepancies within the timelines.
 Oversee the entire process of stock transfers inter warehouse, warehouse to store and store to warehouse, ensure the movements are recorded and updated to reduce discrepancies.
 Provide regular update on pending transfers, WH cycle counts & transparency of trouble coded inventory
 Directly coordinate with suppliers and buying for returning the intended stocks
 Tracking on all WH logs, credit note, RTV adjustments and submit to FSS
 Pass the CN, RTV, Write-off and general adjustment thru system and report to finance.
 Monitor transactions daily, investigating discrepancies and confirming On-base logs are raised. Also reviewing the status of logs to ensure accurate resolution.
 Manage perpetual stock take calendar in conjunction with designated managers and stock take team, communicate the plan, and ensure compliance to the plan.
 Liaise with business inventory managers for monthly shrinkage data and prepare/share the final report.
 Manage the expiry product identification and share the visibility reports with all stakeholders.
 Manage the disposal or RTV of expired and obsolete goods at respective warehouse to ensure high quality standards are maintained in the activities of the Company. 
 Oversee the physical stock count process, review stock count results in conjunction with the management and reconcile the figures by auditing physical stock movements.
 Prepare reports based on the findings and provide recommendations and suggestions to the management
 
 People Management Roles and Responsibilities 
 Coach and motivate reportees to enhance performance and produce quality standards and outputs, ensure that they are continuously developed and provided feedback.
 Review Operational processes from a risk management perspective; identify and qualify new areas of risks and escalate concerns to the site HSE committee.
 Guide and motivate subordinates to enhance performance and produce quality work, and ensure that they are continuously developed for higher level roles.
 Maintain HSE practices in the working environment in order to minimize the opportunity of damage property and injury to self and colleagues. Pro-actively remind colleagues to behave in line with the HSE processes defined by the company
 Regularly communicate to the team on operational performance and brief on upcoming events
 Create a positive work environment that results in low attrition, sickness and absence reduction to ensure that Collective and individual targets are met
 
 Education/Certification and Continued Education 
 Graduate with excellent knowledge of warehousing & inventory management
 
 Years of Experience 
 3-5 years of experience in warehousing & inventory management with knowledge in ecommerce retail environment
 
 Knowledge and Skills 
 Computer Literacy and excellent MS excel skills 
 Highly organized with eye for details
 Preferably Good knowledge in Oracle - WMS 
 Strong Communication and Interpersonal skills 
 Good analytical skills
 
 Languages 
 English

It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

What You’ll Be Doing

Tanagra is looking for a detail-oriented Finance trainee to support the team across key reporting, data consolidation, and month-end closing activities within a fast-paced retail environment. This opportunity is designed to provide hands-on exposure to core finance operations while building strong analytical and organizational skills.

Under the guidance of the Finance team, you will:

  • Support the month-end closing process, including reconciliations and data validation

  • Assist in preparing financial reports, presentations, and consolidated data trackers

  • Support financial monitoring and reporting activities using Excel and PowerPoint

  • Help organize and maintain accurate financial data with strong attention to detail

  • Assist the team with day-to-day finance coordination and ad-hoc reporting tasks

  • Contribute to ongoing finance initiatives and process improvements where needed

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field

  • Basic understanding of finance and accounting principles

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to handle data accurately

  • Well-organized with the ability to manage tasks efficiently

  • Motivated, proactive, and eager to learn within a team environment

What the Group can Offer

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.

Emirati Talent & Inclusive Opportunities

At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to empowering UAE Nationals and fostering local talent as part of our vision for a thriving workforce. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures equal opportunities for all, regardless of gender, age, race, religion, or ability.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
About PAYOK 
 PAYOK is an international payment gateway operating across 7 global markets. We specialize in cross-border payment solutions for merchants in high-risk verticals (iGaming, Forex, Crypto Trading, Social Entertainment).

 Role Summary 
 We are looking for a hands-on Finance Manager to lead the finance and accounting function for our Malaysia operations. The role will be responsible for day-to-day accounting, month-end closing, financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash-flow management, tax and statutory compliance, payroll coordination, internal controls, and financial business partnering.
 The successful candidate should be comfortable doing the work as well as managing the finance function , with strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Accounting & Financial Reporting 
 Manage the full accounting cycle, including AP, AR, GL, bank reconciliation and month-end closing. 
 Prepare monthly management accounts and financial reports. 
 Review P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow statements. 
 Ensure accurate and timely month-end and year-end closing. 
 Prepare financial analysis and variance explanations for management. 
 Coordinate annual audit and work with external auditors. 
 Budgeting & Forecasting 
 Prepare annual budgets and periodic forecasts. 
 Monitor actual performance against budget. 
 Analyze revenue, gross margin, operating expenses and profitability. 
 Provide management with recommendations on cost control and business performance. 
 Cash Flow & Working Capital 
 Manage daily cash-flow requirements and cash forecasting. 
 Monitor accounts receivable and collection performance. 
 Manage accounts payable and payment schedules. 
 Identify opportunities to improve working capital and cash conversion. 
 Tax & Compliance 
 Ensure compliance with Malaysian accounting and tax requirements. 
 Coordinate corporate tax, SST and other applicable tax matters. 
 Work with external tax advisers and accountants where required. 
 Ensure timely submission of statutory filings and payments. 
 Internal Controls 
 Maintain appropriate financial controls and approval processes. 
 Review expenses, payments and financial transactions. 
 Identify financial risks and implement corrective actions. 
 Ensure compliance with company finance policies. 
 Payroll & HR Finance 
 Coordinate monthly payroll accounting and statutory payments with HR/payroll. 
 Review payroll-related accounting and reconciliations. 
 Monitor employee expenses, claims and benefits. 
 Business Partnering 
 Work closely with the Country Manager and other department heads. 
 Provide financial insights to support business decisions. 
 Review profitability by product/channel/business unit where applicable. 
 Support pricing, cost-saving initiatives and new business cases. 
 Provide ad-hoc financial analysis when required. 
 Team Management 
 Manage and develop the local finance team. 
 Review and improve finance processes and workflows. 
 Ensure clear segregation of duties and accountability. 
 Drive automation and process improvements where possible. 

 Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance or related field. 
 ACCA/CPA/CIMA/MIA qualification is preferred. 
 4-5 years of relevant finance/accounting experience , preferably with experience as a Finance Manager. 
 Experience in a medium-sized company or fast-growing business preferred. 
 Strong knowledge of Malaysian accounting, tax and statutory requirements. 
 Strong experience with month-end closing, management reporting, budgeting and cash-flow management. 
 Hands-on experience with ERP/accounting systems. 
 Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 Good English communication skills; Mandarin is an advantage. 
 Able to work independently with limited supervision.

 Maintain proper finance process flows and documentation in place to improve finance operation efficiency and ensure compliance to the accounting standards and respective countries’ regulatory bodies requirement
 Lead, support & provide training to the executives to ensure the team understand the task allocated, priorities, accurate data entry, importance of proper record keeping and meeting the given timelines.

 Ad hoc financial exercise support to the Group Finance Controller, Group CFO and the top management team for strategic business decisions.

 Key Responsibilities

 • Understand the business model, processes and be able to identify process gap to improve the efficiency.
 • Handle full set of accounts and ensure monthly closing are performed in accordance to the monthly closing checklist and accounting standards.
 • Proper review and understanding of each transaction recorded- make sure transactions are supported with proper documentation.
 • Deliver accurate and reliable monthly management account to the senior management on timely basis- by 15th of the month.
 • Prepare month rolling cashflow forecast for top management and identify any potential funding gap.
 • Prepare the corporate office annual budget and monitor actual results against approved budget.
 • Submission of monthly indirect tax returns according to the country’s tax legislation- reconcile tax codes, perform tax lodgements on timely basis.
 • Complete the submission of annual audit and tax compliance before the statutory deadline.
 • Lead TP compliance projects by working closely with group tax manager to ensure full tax compliance for JAG and aviation business.

 B. Team Management: 
 • Ensure completion daily & weekly tasks by Accounts Assistants/Executives/Senior Executives.
 • Providing support, training & management for cost allocations & data entry for the Accounts Assistants/Executives.
 • Oversee the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable functions to ensure completion & closure of each month to pre-determined timelines.
 • Escalation point for specific clients to help resolve issues and close of ad hoc requests.

 C. Special Projects / Ad Hoc: 
 • To work closely with the direct report on understanding the current business model, processes, identify control/process gap and resolve by setting up and implement policies for process improvement.
 • Assist on special project together with the local country team to streamline the finance process (improve effectiveness and efficiency).
 • Drive the special project in clearing backlogs in audit and tax compliance for entities within the Aviation business in order to minimise exposure to the company.
 • Assist in tracking insurance renewal or acquisition in order to mitigate financial risk for the aviation business.
 • Assist in M&A and divestment projects upon request.

 Key Requirements 
 • Candidate must possess Degree/Professional Qualification in accounting or equivalent.
 • At least 7 year(s) of working experience in finance of which 4 years must be in commercial finance.
 • Strong in Microsoft Excel and financial modelling.
 • Experienced with accounting software.
 • Good written and spoken proficiency in English is a pre-requisite.
 • Able to work closely and independently with external auditor and tax agent.
 • Prior audit or accounting service experience is favourable.
 • Reliable and committed to meeting tight deadlines and objectives.
 • Possess positive working attitude and strong leadership quality
 • Excellent problem solving skills and strong business acumen
 • Strong interpersonal skill and able to work with top management

jobs.title: Business Solutions Manager - Data Science & AI Projects (Revenue Management)
jobs.normalized_title: business solutions manager data science & ai projects revenue management
jobs.description:
Turn data science into real-world commercial decisions. 
 We’re looking for a hands-on Data Science and AI professional to join Etihad’s Solutions & Innovation team and help build the next generation of analytical solutions supporting our Revenue Management function.
 This isn’t a role where you’ll simply analyze data and make recommendations.
 You’ll take ownership of data science and machine-learning projects from idea to production – defining the problem, developing the model, building and testing proof-of-concepts, deploying solutions and continuously improving their performance.
 One of your key areas of focus will be the continued development of Etihad’s in-house ancillary dynamic pricing capability , applying data science and machine learning to help make smarter, more responsive commercial decisions at scale.
 You’ll also have the opportunity to identify and build entirely new solutions as Etihad continues to expand the use of advanced analytics, automation and AI across Revenue Management.
 What you’ll do 
 Lead data science, machine-learning and AI projects from ideation and model development through POC, deployment and productionization.
 Develop and enhance machine-learning models supporting dynamic pricing, forecasting, optimization and commercial decision-making.
 Play a key role in evolving our in-house ancillary dynamic pricing capability.
 Identify new opportunities to apply AI, machine learning and advanced analytics to real Revenue Management and commercial challenges.
 Build new analytical products while continuously improving existing models and solutions.
 Test, validate, calibrate and monitor models to ensure they continue to deliver measurable business value.
 Partner with Revenue Management, Digital, Technology & Innovation and Commercial teams to turn complex business problems into scalable technical solutions.
 Translate sophisticated analytical outputs into clear commercial insights that stakeholders can understand and act upon.
 Help move successful prototypes beyond experimentation and into robust, production-ready solutions.
 Support adoption and change, ensuring new solutions become embedded in commercial decision-making.
 Extensive experience in leading the evaluation, implementation, and optimization of dynamic ancillary pricing capabilities to maximize ancillary revenue while enhancing customer value and conversion
 Identify, evaluate, and implement Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning use cases to improve operational efficiency, revenue generation, and customer experience
 Promote the adoption of AI-driven insights and automation across commercial processes to support innovation and continuous improvement
 Why this role? 
 This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data science, AI and commercial aviation .
 Rather than developing models that remain experimental, you’ll see your work translated into solutions used to support real commercial decisions across Etihad. You’ll inherit existing products to improve, including our ancillary dynamic pricing capability, while also having the opportunity to develop new solutions from the ground up.
 As Etihad continues its growth under Journey 2030, you’ll be joining a team focused on using technology, advanced analytics and innovation to rethink how commercial decisions are made.
 If you’re a data scientist who wants to move beyond experimentation and build solutions that make it all the way into production, we’d like to hear from you.

What we’re looking for 
 You’ll bring a strong combination of hands-on data science capability and project leadership . You should be equally comfortable getting into the technical detail of a model and working with business stakeholders to understand the commercial problem you’re trying to solve.
 Ideally, you’ll have:
 A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Technology or another relevant quantitative discipline.
 5+ years’ experience across data science, machine learning, AI or advanced analytics.
 Strong hands-on experience building machine-learning models and taking them through the complete lifecycle into production.
 Strong Python and/or R capability and experience working with modern data science tools and platforms.
 Experience working with large, complex datasets and developing scalable analytical solutions.
 Exposure to platforms such as Databricks and cloud environments including GCP, Azure or AWS.
 Strong project leadership and stakeholder management capability.
 The ability to explain complex technical concepts and model outputs in commercially meaningful terms.
 Knowledge of Revenue Management, pricing, forecasting or optimization would be highly valuable.
 Airline or travel industry experience would be strongly preferred, but we’re open to candidates who can demonstrate strong data science capability and the ability to apply it to complex commercial problems.

Recruitment Process 
 The recruitment process for this position will involve the following steps:
 Applications will be reviewed by a human-member of our Recruitment Team
 Shortlisted applicants will be invited to completed a recorded video interview via our third-party platform HireVue. This interview will allow you to record your responses to a range of questions related to the position and will allow you to demonstrate your knowledge and experience in a way that just your CV alone would not be able to. It also ensures fairness for you and all candidates, as all of our shortlisted candidates are asked the same questions and assessed on their responses. 
 After a review of completed video interviews, shortlisted candidates will be invited to an initial technical interview with the hiring manager.
 Finalists may be invited to a follow up interview. This interview will involve the completion and presentation of relevant business case.
 All candidates will be notified as to the status of their application as soon as is possible.
 
 Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.
 To learn more visit www.etihad.com 
 Recruitment Fraud Alert 

Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

About The Role

 The Finance Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing core finance functions, ensuring compliance with international financial standards, and supporting strategic decision-making. This role manages financial operations, reporting, controls, and a team of finance professionals while partnering with senior leadership to drive business performance.

 Job Responsibilities

 Plan, organise, and manage finance operations including treasury, corporate finance, M&A, and risk management.
 Develop financial plans, strategies, and policies.
 Maintain accounting, reporting policies, and internal controls.
 Analyse and present financial results to support decision-making.
 Lead audits (internal and external), budgeting, forecasting, and monthly closing.
 Manage a team of finance professionals.
 Oversee Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and tax compliance (VAT and corporate tax).
 Manage treasury activities and cash flow.

 Minimum Qualifications

 Minimum 10 years of finance experience, including managerial responsibility.
 CPA (USA) or Chartered Accountant (India) qualification.
 Strong knowledge of international financial and regulatory standards.
 Experience in financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and consolidation.
 Exposure to treasury operations and financial modelling.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office and finance systems (e.g., Hyperion, Oracle).
 Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
 Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines.

 Preferred Qualifications

 Experience managing larger or multi-functional finance teams.

 Exposure to international or complex organisational environments

Join a purpose-driven organization where bold ideas are encouraged, collaboration drives progress, and your growth fuels our shared success.

jobs.description:
A little taste of your day-to-day:

Bottom line? We’re looking for a new Finance and Business Support Manager comfortable with balancing the books when it comes to managing the needs of owners, auditors and regulatory agencies while also monitoring and improving hotel profitability. In return, we’ll put our financial operations and the security of our hotel assets in your expert hands.

Every day is different, but you’ll mostly be:

 Managing and coaching your team to ensure the right person is always on the right task
 Setting exceptional accounting practice standards and ensuring financial control procedures remain ethical and legal
 Maximising financial returns through financial analysis, data trends and market information – while budgeting accordingly
 Enhancing the guest experience through improved payment options, inventory controls and financial dispute resolution
 Supervising a number of clerical accounting employees across a range of functions – from Accounts Payable to Purchasing and Payroll.

 What We need from you:

 Bachelor’s degree / higher education qualification / equivalent in Accounting and Finance  
 4-8 years’ experience in hotel accounting or auditing with at least one year in an Assistant Controller or similar supervisory role, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience 
 Knowledge of accounting management duties e.g., negotiating hotel space and tenant leases, processing payroll, performing asset management duties, providing business projections, displacement analysis, preparing government reports, filing tax returns etc
 Professional accounting or finance designation or certification preferred  
 Other languages beneficial

 What you can expect from us:

We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life – including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well – both inside and outside of work – and through our myWellbeing

framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

So, join us and you’ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

 Job Summary

 We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Finance Manager to oversee our financial operations, manage financial reporting, and drive strategic financial planning. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial management, a keen analytical mind, and excellent leadership skills.

 Key Responsibilities

 Review monthly and quarterly management reports and prepare presentations for senior management, including variance analyses and financial insights.
 Collaborate with senior management to develop financial strategies and support business decision-making.
 Monitor financial performance against targets and prepare variance reports.

 Lead and develop the finance team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.

 Qualifications

 Degree holder in Finance, Accounting or equivalent professional qualifications
 CPA/ACCA or equivalent certification.
 Minimum 8 years of relevant accounting experience, with initial experience acquired in Big 4 is preferred.
 Familiar with group accounting policies, tax requirement and internal control procedures. Experience in US GAAP and Sarbanes-Oxley Act compliance is an advantage.
 Experience in SAP S/4HANA would be advantageous.
 Self-motivated and high degree of initiative, high level of integrity with a strong sense of urgency
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly.

 DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

jobs.description:
The Finance Manager plays a critical role in leading the month-end close process, overseeing financial reporting, and performing detailed variance analysis to ensure accuracy, transparency, and compliance with accounting standards. This position offers the opportunity to gain deep exposure to the accounting operations of a multinational organization while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and strengthen internal controls. The role partners cross-functionally to assess financial risks, deliver actionable insights, and support leadership in driving informed, strategic business decisions. Strong communication and organizational skills are essential to successfully manage timelines, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure high-quality deliverables.

 Who We Are

jobs.description:
About the Role 
 We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Finance Manager with strong experience in the Technology, IT, AI, Software, or related digital industry to oversee the company's financial operations and provide strategic financial insights to support business growth.
 This role will be responsible for financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow management, management accounting, financial controls, compliance, and business performance analysis. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced technology environment and partnering closely with senior management and business teams to drive financial performance.

 What You Will Do 

 Financial Management & Reporting
 Oversee the company's day-to-day finance and accounting operations.
 Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports and management accounts.
 Analyse financial performance, revenue, expenses, margins, and key business metrics.
 Provide management with financial insights, variance analysis, and recommendations to support business decisions.
 Monitor and analyse profitability across different business units, projects, products, or services.
 Ensure timely and accurate month-end and year-end closing activities.
 Oversee account consolidation and ensure accuracy of financial records.

 Budgeting, Forecasting & FP&A
 Lead the annual budgeting and financial planning process.
 Prepare rolling forecasts and cash flow projections.
 Monitor actual performance against budget and identify key variances.
 Work closely with business and operational teams to develop realistic financial plans and forecasts.
 Provide financial modelling and scenario analysis to support business expansion and investment decisions.
 Identify opportunities for cost optimisation and improved financial performance.

 Cash Flow & Treasury Management
 Manage and monitor the company's cash flow position and working capital.
 Prepare regular cash flow forecasts and ensure sufficient liquidity to support business operations.
 Monitor accounts receivable and accounts payable to ensure timely collections and payments.
 Manage banking relationships and coordinate banking facilities where required.
 Monitor cash utilisation and ensure effective allocation of company funds.

 Commercial & Business Finance
 Partner with senior management and business teams to evaluate financial performance and business opportunities.
 Support commercial decision-making through financial analysis and business modelling.
 Review pricing, project costing, revenue projections, and profitability.
 Analyse the financial performance of technology projects, software solutions, AI initiatives, and other business lines.
 Provide financial input for new projects, investments, contracts, and expansion plans.
 Develop financial dashboards and KPIs to track business performance.

 Compliance, Tax & Internal Controls
 Ensure compliance with applicable Malaysian statutory and regulatory requirements.
 Oversee compliance relating to LHDN, SST, E-Invoicing, EPF, SOCSO, HRDF , and other relevant requirements.
 Coordinate with external auditors, tax agents, company secretaries, bankers, and other professional advisers.
 Ensure timely completion of audits, tax filings, statutory submissions, and financial reporting requirements.
 Establish, review, and improve internal financial controls and processes.
 Ensure proper documentation and controls are maintained across finance operations.

 Process Improvement & Systems
 Review and improve finance processes, policies, and internal controls to support business growth.
 Identify opportunities to automate and streamline financial reporting and accounting processes.
 Work closely with IT and internal teams to improve the use of accounting and financial management systems.
 Ensure financial data is accurate, timely, and readily available for management reporting.
 Support implementation or enhancement of ERP, accounting, reporting, and finance systems where required.

 What You Should Have
 Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Accountancy, Banking, or a related field .
 Professional qualification such as ACCA, CPA, CIMA, MIA , or equivalent will be an advantage.
 Minimum 5–8 years of relevant finance and accounting experience , with at least 2–3 years in a managerial or supervisory capacity .
 Strong preference for candidates from the Technology, IT, AI, Software, SaaS, FinTech, Digital, or other technology-driven industries. 
 Experience in management accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management.
 Strong experience in FP&A, financial analysis, financial modelling, and business performance reporting .
 Experience with account consolidation and month-end/year-end closing.
 Strong understanding of Malaysian accounting standards, taxation, and statutory requirements.
 Familiarity with LHDN, SST, E-Invoicing, EPF, SOCSO, HRDF , and other relevant Malaysian compliance requirements.
 Experience working with accounting/ERP systems such as SQL, Xero, QuickBooks, SAP, Oracle, Zoho , or similar platforms.
 Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate financial data into actionable business insights.
